collectible:1.text: Hidden Packages are collectibles in Grand Theft Auto III, Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, Grand Theft Auto Advance, Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories and Grand Theft Auto V. The collection of hidden packages in the series is considered a side quest of sorts as the player is given the opportunity to amass rewards by collecting as many of these pickups as possible.

collectible:3.text: Unique Stunt Jumps (also known as Unique Jumps in 3D Universe and Stunt Jumps in GTA IV) are a feature in every Grand Theft Auto game since GTA III (with the exception of GTA Advance). All GTA games have jumps set up around their maps for "insane" stunting.

easter-egg:2.text: The Easter Egg Building is an unnamed building in Downtown Vice City that appears in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories. The building is located between the VCN Building and the Roxor International Building.

easter-egg:3.text: Mulholland is a rich residential district in Los Santos, San Andreas. Mulholland is located in the northwestern area of the city. Richman is located west of the district, Mulholland Intersection and part of Red County to the east, Red County and Dillimore to the north, Vinewood and Temple to the south.

easter-egg:4.text: Scope Out: Submarine is a setup mission for The McTony Robbery, featured in Grand Theft Auto Online as part of The Chop Shop update. The mission is started at the Planning Computer inside the Salvage Yard, and is available after choosing one of the target vehicles available. This mission is the first preparation needed for The McTony Robbery.

easter-egg:5.text: Fixed-wing aircraft, also known as aeroplanes (British English) or airplanes (American English), are aircraft that are capable of flight using wings for lift when in motion and propellers or jet engines for thrust. Aeroplanes were first made available as controllable vehicles with the introduction of the Dodo in Grand Theft Auto III, which was significantly difficult to fly.

easter-egg:8.text: 98¢ Store is a chain of convenience stores appearing in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. The stores are located around Los Santos, San Andreas. The business has branches in Las Colinas, Willowfield, Downtown Los Santos, Verdant Bluffs, and Ganton. A shop in Willowfield has a gang tag on the side of it. The stores are inaccessible to the player and play no role in the storyline whatsoever.

easter-egg:9.text: Pool or Eight-Ball is a sport in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas and Grand Theft Auto IV. Pool is a two-player game. The aim is to get all the colored balls within the designated colors into the pockets in the table and then pocket the black 8-ball to win. Green pool tables were first seen in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, however, it could not be played by the player.

easter-egg:12.text: Mandarin Mayhem - Phone 6: Mission 1 is a mission in Grand Theft Auto available during San Andreas Chapter 1: Mandarin Mayhem, given to the protagonist by Uncle Fu's Crime Syndicate contact. The mission is available from the second phone (from the left) in north Sunview in San Andreas.

easter-egg:13.text: The Driver is a Malibu Club asset mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which protagonist Tommy Vercetti does independently, located in Vice Point, Vice City. Tommy, Ken and Phil are all in the club, with Tommy saying that the heist plan is coming together nicely, and the only thing left to do is to hire a driver. Ken suggests himself, but Phil suggests Hilary King, describing him as a great driver.

easter-egg:14.text: The Getaway is the last mission in Grand Theft Auto III given to protagonist Claude by Joey Leone from his garage in Trenton, Portland, Liberty City. Joey offers Claude one last job - to assist a few friends of his in a bank robbery, with Claude acting as a getaway driver.

easter-egg:15.text: True Grime Street Cleaners is a sanitation business that appears in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. It is advertised on billboards around the state of San Andreas. Its slogan is "Get rid of old rubbish, fast!" and its name is a parody of the GTA clone True Crime: Streets of LA. It may be a reference to the term that police officers are occasionally referred to as 'garbage men with badges'.

easter-egg:16.text: Apartment 3c is an apartment room located south of a Pay 'n' Spray in Ocean Beach, Vice City, appearing in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories. The building has a pink roof with a Unique Stunt Jump and parked Sparrow on it. On its south side there are stairways leading up to the apartment room. A Chainsaw is located in its bathroom.

easter-egg:20.text: Escobar is a neighborhood in the Industrial District, Anywhere City, in Grand Theft Auto 2. It is controlled by the Zaibatsu Corporation. It is most likely named after the infamous Colombian drug lord, Pablo Escobar.

easter-egg:22.text: Laura Shrub is a character who is mentioned in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. Laura is is the wife of Congressman Alex Shrub. However, she has moved from Vice City to Alabama, and in the meantime her husband is cheating on her with a porn star known as Candy Suxxx. This is believed to be a reference to Jacqueline Kennedy, the wife of former US President John F. Kennedy and his womanizing habits.

easter-egg:23.text: Steve Scott is a movie personality mentioned in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online. Steve Scott is a honored celebrity on the Vinewood Walk of Fame, credited as a personality in the movie industry. No information is given about this celebrity's background, origin, or films in which he is credited in.

easter-egg:24.text: Keep Your Friends Close... is the final storyline mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which Tommy Vercetti performs independently from his mansion in Starfish Island, Vice City. After failing to forcibly tax Tommy's businesses, Forelli Crime Family Don Sonny Forelli is heading to Vice City from Liberty City in order to deal with Tommy in person and reclaim his "cut".

easter-egg:25.text: Publicity Tour is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by heavy metal band Love Fist from their recording studio in Downtown, Vice City. Just like other missions for Love Fist (Love Juice and Psycho Killer) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.
